# AIToolsEssentials

> Evidence-first AI tools directory: 40+ independently reviewed tools with pricing verified from official vendor pages (dated), buyer guides by audience and workflow, head-to-head comparisons, and versioned benchmark evidence.

The site is designed for people choosing which AI tools to pay for. Editorial scores are independent ratings; hands-on test results are labeled as such; benchmark data includes exact model versions and snapshot dates.

## Main sections
- /tools/: individual tool reviews with verified pricing
- /comparisons/: head-to-head comparisons (e.g., chatgpt-vs-claude, zapier-vs-make-vs-n8n)
- /articles/: buyer guides by audience (agencies, freelancers, developers) and question-intent answers
- /benchmarks/: versioned external benchmark evidence hub
- /pricing/: free directory vs $12/mo premium research membership
- /advertise/: sponsorship information

## Data access
- sitemap.xml lists all pages
- data/tools.json is the structured review dataset

## Policies
- Pricing claims are verified against official vendor pages and re-checked monthly; verification dates shown on-page.
- Reviews include cons and tradeoffs. Sponsored content is labeled per FTC rules in legal/affiliate-disclosure.html.

Contact: contact@aitoolsessentials.com
